title: Post-installed anchors.
officialText:
The installation of post-installed mechanical anchors, adhesive anchors, and screw anchors shall
comply with Table 1704.32. The special inspection shall include the verification of compliance with approved construction documents
and standards established by the commissioner pursuant to Section 28-113.2.2 of the Administrative Code.
*1704.33 Tenant protection plan. When alteration, partial alteration, or construction operations are performed at occupied multiple
dwellings, the department shall periodically verify compliance with a tenant protection plan as provided for in Chapter 1 of Title 28 of
the Administrative Code and Section 3303.10.
*Section 1704.33 was added by Local Law 116 of 2019. This law has an effective date of March 8, 2020.
